result.title: Evolving Agent Teams
result.summary: The rapid progress of software engineering agents drives interest in applying them to open-ended problems such as GPU kernel optimization. However, we find that existing coding agents converge to local optima on real-world, expert-written kernels (e.g., FlashInfer). We introduce Evolving Agent Teams, a multi-agent framework that escapes such local optima. It features (1) a central supervisor that diagnoses each local optimum and restructures a team of agents; and (2) a persistent file system that comprises a learning document, an evolution history, and per-team artifacts, grounding restructuring with accumulated experience. Under a matched token budget, Evolving Agent Teams consistently outperforms strong coding-agent baselines. With an extended token budget, Evolving Agent Teams generates a CUDA kernel that reaches 1.2x mean speedup over the production FlashInfer MLA paged decode kernel from scratch and wins on 36 of 47 production workloads from FlashInfer-Bench (0.86-0.99x on the remaining 11). It also demonstrates superior performance on tasks such as KDA prefill on AMD MI350X (3.01x over vLLM) and NVIDIA B200 (3.44x over FlashKDA), MoE expert-offload serving on Apple silicon (30.3 tokens/s decode for Qwen3.8-Flash-Next in MLX 4-bit on a 48 GB M4 Pro), and RoboDojo robot manipulation (62.1 on held-out seeds vs. 55.3 for the best leaderboard entry). Code is available at https://github.com/caoshiyi/EAT.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 Evolving Agent Teams 多智能体框架，用中央 supervisor 诊断局部最优并重组智能体团队，配合持久文件系统（学习文档、演化历史、团队产物）为重组提供经验支撑，并在 GPU kernel 优化等任务上验证效果。
AI.relevance_reason: 属于软件工程智能体领域，与视觉推理无直接关联；但其「诊断局部最优—重组—依赖持久演化历史」的机制，可能为 LVR 中跨步状态/经验记忆如何指导搜索与停止决策提供类比线索，需核查其状态抽象是否可迁移。
